script: セイバールート三日目-08
title: セイバールート三日目-08

pages.ja:
炎の中にいた。
崩れ落ちる家と焼けこげていく人たち。
走っても走っても風景はみな赤色。
これは十年前の光景だ。
長く、思い出す事のなかった過去の記憶。
その中を、再現するように走った。
pages.jaRuby:
炎の中にいた。
崩れ落ちる家と焼けこげていく人たち。
走っても走っても風景はみな[ruby text=せきしょく char=2]赤色。
これは十年前の光景だ。
長く、思い出す事のなかった過去の記憶。
その中を、再現するように走った。
pages.en:
I am in the flames.

Houses collapse. People burn black.

No matter how far I run, everything remains red.

This is the scene from ten years ago.

A memory from the past I have not recalled in a very long time.

I run through it as though reenacting what happened.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I’m in a fire.
Collapsing buildings and burning people.
No matter how far I run, the scenery is always red.
This is a vision of ten years ago.
A memory of the distant past I haven’t remembered in a while.
I run through it, as if recreating the scene.

pages.ja:
悪い夢だと知りながら出口はない。
走って走って、どこまでも走って。
行き着く先は結局、力尽きて助けられる、幼い頃の自分だった。
pages.jaRuby:
悪い夢だと知りながら出口はない。
走って走って、どこまでも走って。
行き着く先は結局、力尽きて助けられる、幼い頃の自分だった。
pages.en:
I know it is a nightmare, but there is no way out.

I run and run, then run still farther.

But the path always ends in the same place: with the child I once was, his strength exhausted, waiting to be saved.
pages.mirrorMoon:
There’s no escape even though I know it’s a dream.
I run, run, keep running.
In the end, where I end up is how I’m saved after running out of energy.

」
嫌な気分のまま目が覚めた。
額に触れると、冬だと言うのにひどく汗をかいていた。

“—”

I wake with the nightmare still clinging to me.

When I touch my forehead, I find myself drenched in sweat despite the winter cold.

I wake up with a bad feeling.
A feeling like a metal weight is inside my chest.
I feel my forehead and find that I’m sweating a lot even though it’s winter.

pages.ja:
「……ああ、もうこんな時間か」
時計は六時を過ぎていた。
耳を澄ませば、台所からはトントンと包丁の音が聞こえてくる。
「桜、今朝も早いな」
感心している場合じゃない。
こっちもさっさと支度をして、朝食の手伝いをしなければ。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“…It's this late already?”

The clock has passed six.

When I listen, I can hear the rhythmic knock of a knife against the cutting board in the kitchen.

“Sakura's up early again.”

This is no time to lie here admiring her dedication.

I need to get dressed and help with breakfast.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Oh, it’s already this late?”
It’s already past six o’clock.
From the kitchen, I can hear the sound of the kitchen knife cutting something.
“Sakura is early as usual.”
There’s no time to be impressed.
I have to get ready quickly and go help fix breakfast.

pages.ja:
「士郎、今日どうするのよ。土曜日だから午後はアルバイト？」
「いや、バイトは入ってないよ。一成のところでなんかやってると思うけど、それがどうかしたか？」
「んー、べつに。暇だったら道場の方に遊びにきてくんないかなーって。わたし、今月ピンチなのだ」
「？ ピンチって、何がさ」
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Shirou, what are you doing today? It's Saturday, so are you working this afternoon?”

“No, I don't have a shift. I'll probably be helping Issei with something. Why?”

“Oh, no reason. I was only thinking you might come visit the dojo if you're free. I'm in dire straits this month.”

“? What kind of dire straits?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Shirou, what are you gonna do today? Will you be working this afternoon ’cause it’s Saturday?”
“No, I don’t have work today. I think I’ll be doing something with Issei. Why?”
“Oh, nothing. I just hoped you might come and visit me at the dojo today. I’m in a pinch this month.”
“Hm? In a pinch? What is?”

pages.ja:
「お財布事情がピンチなの。誰かがお弁当作ってくれると嬉しいんだけどなー」
「断る。自業自得だ、たまには一食ぐらい抜いたほうがいい」
「ふーんだ、士郎には期待してないもん。わたしが頼りにしてるのは桜ちゃんだけなんだから。ね、桜ちゃん？」
pages.jaRuby:
「お財布事情がピンチなの。誰かがお弁当作ってくれると嬉しいんだけどなー」

「ふーんだ、士郎には期待してないもん。わたしが頼りにしてるのは桜ちゃんだけなんだから。ね、桜ちゃん？」
pages.en:
“The financial kind. If only somebody would make me a boxed lunch.”

“No. You brought it on yourself. Missing a meal for once might do you good.”

“Hmph. It's not as if I expected anything from you, Shirou. Sakura is the only one I can rely on. Isn't that right, Sakura?”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“My wallet. I’d be really happy if someone made me lunch.”
“I refuse. It’s your own fault, so you should skip a meal once in a while.”
“Heh, I’m not expecting anything from Shirou. The only one I’m depending on is Sakura-chan. Right, Sakura-chan?”

pages.ja:
「はい。わたしと同じ物でよろしければ用意しておきますね、先生」
「うん、おっけーおっけー。じゃあ今日は一緒にお昼を食べましょう」
pages.jaRuby:
「はい。わたしと同じ物でよろしければ用意しておきますね、先生」
「うん、おっけーおっけー。じゃあ今日は一緒にお昼を食べましょう」
pages.en:
“Yes. If you do not mind having the same thing as me, I'll prepare one for you, Ms. Fujimura.”

“Mm-hm, perfect, perfect. Then let's have lunch together today.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Yes. If you don’t mind having the same lunch as me, I can prepare one.”
“Yep, fine, fine. Let’s eat lunch together today then.”

pages.ja:
いつも通りに朝食は進んでいく。
今朝のメニューは定番の他、主菜でレンコンとこんにゃくのいり鶏が用意されていた。
朝っぱらからこんな手の込んだ物を作らなくとも、と思うのだが、きっと大量に作って昼の弁当に使うのだろう。
桜は弓道部員だし、藤ねえは弓道部の顧問だ。
二人が弁当で結ばれるのも至極当然の流れと言える。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
Breakfast proceeds as usual.

Alongside the regular staples, this morning's main dish is *iri-dori*: chicken simmered with lotus root and konjac.

It seems excessive to prepare something so involved first thing in the morning, but Sakura probably made a large batch to pack into lunch boxes later.

She belongs to the archery club, and Fuji is its faculty advisor.

It is only natural that lunch should unite the two of them.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Breakfast continues as usual.
Today, along with the usual, there’s simmered lotus root with chicken.
I don’t think she has to make anything this elaborate for breakfast, but I think she made a lot of it to take for lunch too.
Sakura is a member of the archery club, and Fuji-nee is in charge of the archery club.
It’s natural for them to share lunches.

pages.ja:
「そう言えば士郎。今朝は遅かったけど、何かあった？」
みそ汁を飲みながらこっちに視線を向ける藤ねえ。
……ったく。普段は抜けているクセに、こういう時だけ鋭いんだから。
pages.jaRuby:
「そう言えば士郎。今朝は遅かったけど、何かあった？」

……ったく。普段は抜けているクセに、こういう時だけ鋭いんだから。
pages.en:
“Come to think of it, Shirou, you were late this morning. Did something happen?”

Fuji looks over at me as she drinks her miso soup.

…Honestly. She bumbles through ordinary life, but at times like this she is remarkably perceptive.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Oh yeah, Shirou, you were late this morning. Did something happen?”
Fuji-nee looks at me, sipping her miso soup.
…Geez. She’s usually slow, but she gets sharp only at times like this.

pages.ja:
「昔の夢を見た。寝覚めがすっげー悪かっただけで、あとはなんともない」
「なんだ、いつもの事か。なら安心かな」
とりわけ興味なさそうに会話を切る藤ねえ。
こっちもホントに気にしていないので、ムキになる話でもない。
pages.jaRuby:
「昔の夢を見た。寝覚めがすっげー悪かっただけで、あとはなんともない」
「なんだ、いつもの事か。なら安心かな」
とりわけ興味なさそうに会話を切る藤ねえ。

pages.en:
“I dreamed about the past. Just woke up feeling awful, that's all. Nothing else is wrong.”

“Oh, the usual. Then I suppose there's nothing to worry about.”

With no particular interest, Fuji lets the conversation drop.

I truly am not concerned either, so there is no reason to make an issue of it.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“I had a dream about my past. I just woke up grouchy, that’s all.”
“I see, nothing unusual. I’m relieved.”
Fuji-nee ends the conversation like she’s not interested.
I’m not worried at all about it either, so I shouldn’t get mad about it.

pages.ja:
十年前。
まだあの火事の記憶を忘れられない頃は、頻繁に夢にうなされていた。
それも月日が経つごとになくなって、今では夢を見てもさらりと流せるぐらいには立ち直れている。
……ただ、当時はわりと酷かったらしく、その時からうちにいた藤ねえは、俺のそういった変化には敏感なのだ。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
Ten years ago.

Back when I still could not forget the fire, nightmares plagued me often.

They faded as the years passed. Now I have recovered enough that even when I dream of it, I can let it wash over me and move on.

…Apparently it was quite bad at the time, though. Fuji has been part of this household since then, which makes her sensitive to changes of that sort.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Ten years ago.
I used to have nightmares back when I couldn’t get the fire out of my mind.
But I saw less of it as time passed, and I’m well over it now that I can let it slide even after dreaming about it.
…But I guess it was pretty bad back then. Since Fuji-nee has been here since that time, she’s sensitive to my change.

pages.ja:
「士郎、食欲はある？ 今朝にかぎってないとかない？」
「ない。なんともないんだから、人の夢にかこつけてメシを横取りするな」
「ちぇっ。士郎が強くなってくれて嬉しいけど、もちょっと繊細でいてくれたほうがいいな、お姉ちゃんは」
pages.jaRuby:
「士郎、食欲はある？ 今朝にかぎってないとかない？」
「ない。なんともないんだから、人の夢にかこつけてメシを横取りするな」
「ちぇっ。士郎が強くなってくれて嬉しいけど、もちょっと繊細でいてくれたほうがいいな、お姉ちゃんは」
pages.en:
“Shirou, do you have an appetite? You haven't suddenly lost it this morning, have you?”

“No, I haven't. I told you I'm fine, so stop using my dream as an excuse to steal my food.”

“Aw. I'm glad you've grown tougher, Shirou, but your big sister wishes you'd stayed just a little more delicate.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Shirou, are you not hungry? You don’t happen to have no appetite this morning, right?”
“I am hungry. I’m fine, so don’t try to take my food using my dream as an excuse.”
“Man, I’m glad you’ve gotten so strong, but personally, I wish you were more delicate.”

pages.ja:
「そりゃこっちの台詞だ。もちっと可憐になってくれたほうがいいぞ、弟分としては」
ふん、とお互い視線を交わさないで罵りあう。
それが元気な証拠となって、藤ねえは安心したように笑った。
pages.jaRuby:
「そりゃこっちの台詞だ。もちっと可憐になってくれたほうがいいぞ、弟分としては」
ふん、とお互い視線を交わさないで罵りあう。
それが元気な証拠となって、藤ねえは安心したように笑った。
pages.en:
“That's my line. As your honorary little brother, I wish you'd become a little more dainty.”

We trade insults without looking at one another, each giving an offended snort.

Taking it as proof that I am well, Fuji smiles in relief.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“That’s my line. I wish you’d be more sweet.”
We make fun of each other without looking at each other.
That proves my liveliness, and Fuji-nee laughs with relief.

pages.ja:
「
ふん」
正直、その心遣いは嬉しい。
ま、感謝すると付け上がるので、いつも通り不満そうに鼻を鳴らす。
「？？」
そんな俺たちを見て、事情を知らない桜が不思議そうに首をかしげていた。
pages.jaRuby:
「
ふん」

ま、感謝すると付け上がるので、いつも通り不満そうに鼻を鳴らす。
「？？」

pages.en:
“—Hmph.”

To be honest, I appreciate her concern.

But gratitude would only go to her head, so I snort with my usual show of displeasure.

“??”

Sakura, unaware of the history behind this exchange, tilts her head in confusion as she watches us.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Heh.”
To be honest, I’m glad she’s worrying.
But she’ll be elated if I thank her, so I act like I’m discontented.
“?”
Not knowing the circumstances, Sakura looks puzzled at the way we’re acting.
